title: Mn2+-assisted high-capacity retention in iron–chromium flow batteries via hydrogen evolution inhibition and Cr3+/Cr2+ activation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1714-1721
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09027J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tian-Ying Zhang, Zheng-Rong Niu, Bo Li, Yuan-Yuan Cui, Nai-Cai Xu, Xin-Qian Li, Shao-Ju Bian, Ya-Ping Dong, Hai-Tao Feng, Yan-Feng Gao
Herein, Mn2+ improves the capacity retention of the ICRFB by inhibiting hydrogen evolution reaction and activating Cr3+/Cr2+ activity with 0.002 mol L−1 Mn2+, resulting the great enhancement with capacity retention from 39 % to 73 %.
